comment: Hot-updatable fingerprint data. Version pools and client strings must track the real Antigravity product; update this file (or ship an override) when a release ships. Kept out of code so stale versions never get compiled in. The pool is only a last-resort fallback: production passes the resolved version explicitly (see runtime/version.ts), so a stale entry here can no longer reach the wire on its own. versionPool tracks the DESKTOP/hub line (2.x), because the backend refuses every 1.x value as 'no longer supported' (measured 2026-11-12, docs/official-identity.json version.wireVersionGate); the CLI release line is retired server-side. The UA that carries it is the short 'antigravity/<version> <platform>' shape, which does NOT name the hub. Keep exactly one entry: a multi-entry pool can hand out an older client when a caller forgets to pass a version, and a fingerprint's version is frozen for the account's life.
